mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 62 degrees under clear skies at Fireman's Park, with a New Moon overhead.
The city has been busy, recently celebrating the unanimous adoption of the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan and maintaining a top-tier Moody's Aa1 credit rating.
Today features live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness, followed by trivia nights throughout next week at various local venues.
On September 28, a 71-year-old man was cited for failing to keep his vehicle under control during a crash at the intersection of CTH-PB and CTH-M.
Caramel Cashew is the featured flavor of the day, and you can pick it up when the restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM.
